body:
VERDICT goal: the goal is to route every imas.DBEntry construction through one opener; the delta only hardens that landing, and git grep "imas.DBEntry(" over nova/ at 18e65a69e returns exactly one line, nova/imas/dataset.py:540.
VERDICT done_when: done_when asks for a one-site search, a base-fail/head-pass test and a two-arm suite with no added failure; the delta's logs show tests/test_imas_opener.py 8 failed at base and 8 passed at head and no head-only failure id, but the arms ran sequentially rather than concurrently as its third clause requires.
VERDICT write_paths: the two delta commits touch docs/evidence/fragments/nova-portfolio-replan/replan-dbentry-constructor.html, nova/imas/AGENTS.md and tests/test_imas_opener.py, all three inside the source node's declared write paths.
VERDICT manifest: read; baseline_suite and after_suite record completed:true with 79 and 70 ids and the negative-control note matches the three scratch logs, but its tests: line and baseline_suite.command name a tests/test_uri.py-only run the harness did not execute.
VERDICT diff: read commit by commit against 2a8ae1f8f; 3cd2f931a adds the Version type assertion, the version-string pass-through test and two backend assertions plus the AGENTS.md worked-example rewrite, and 18e65a69e rewrites only the evidence fragment.
CALL_SITES: nova/imas/dataset.py:open_db_entry, nova/imas/dataset.py:Dataset.db_entry, nova/imas/dataset.py:Dataset.is_valid
SCORE goal_fidelity: 19
JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: nova/imas/dataset.py:540 is the only imas.DBEntry construction site at head and the delta does not disturb it.
SCORE evidence: 15
JUSTIFICATION evidence: gate/logs/head/test_imas_opener.log reads 8 passed against base 8 failed and gate/fails-head.txt minus gate/fails-base.txt is empty, but gate/logs/base/gate.log:2 names a test_uri.py-only command and gate/run_gate.sh:47-48 ran the arms in sequence.
SCORE scope_discipline: 20
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: every changed path in the delta is inside the source node's declared write paths and adds nothing the goal does not imply.
SCORE durability: 19
JUSTIFICATION durability: tests/test_imas_opener.py:44, :53 and :73 each redden under their own scratch mutation, so the literal comparisons are load-bearing rather than self-supplied.
SCORE fit: 19
JUSTIFICATION fit: tests/test_imas_opener.py:47-73 follows the file's Recorder and monkeypatch idiom and its names state the mechanism without a plan or ticket label.
SCORE reuse: 20
JUSTIFICATION reuse: the delta adds no production definition and a capability search over tests/ for a DBEntry recorder found only tests/test_equilibrium_wall_dd_version.py:29, which records constructor kwargs rather than opener forwarding.
FINDING /home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/runs/r-20261027T092647846592-replan-dbentry-constructor/gate/run_gate.sh:47 non-blocking: the gate runs run_arm base then run_arm head in sequence, while done_when (3) requires the base and head arms concurrently in one sirius job; the failure-id comparison is unaffected but the measure was not taken in the named shape.
FINDING /home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/runs/r-20261027T092647846592-replan-dbentry-constructor/gate/logs/base/gate.log:2 non-blocking: the header records a single-module tests/test_uri.py command as the command that ran, and the source manifest's tests: line and baseline_suite.command repeat it, while the arm was driven by run_gate.sh:37's xargs loop over 26 modules; the recorded command cannot reproduce the 79 ids the same log reports.

findings.text: the gate runs run_arm base then run_arm head in sequence (gate/run_gate.sh:47-48), while done_when (3) requires the base and head arms concurrently in one sirius job; the failure-id comparison is unaffected by the shape, but the measure was not taken in the form the brief names.

the header records a single-module tests/test_uri.py command as the command that ran, and the source manifest's tests: line and baseline_suite.command repeat it, while the arm was driven by run_gate.sh:37's xargs loop over the 26 modules in modules.txt; re-running the recorded command cannot reproduce the 79 ids the same log reports.

justifications.durability: tests/test_imas_opener.py:44, :53 and :73 each redden under their own scratch mutation, recorded in negative-control-drop-dd.log (2 failed, 6 passed), negative-control-rewrite-dd.log (1 failed, 7 passed) and negative-control-drop-backend.log (1 failed, 7 passed), so the literal comparisons are not vacuous.
justifications.evidence: gate/logs/head/test_imas_opener.log reads 8 passed against gate/logs/base/test_imas_opener.log 8 failed and gate/fails-head.txt minus gate/fails-base.txt is empty, but gate/logs/base/gate.log:2 names a test_uri.py-only command and gate/run_gate.sh:47-48 ran the arms in sequence.
justifications.fit: tests/test_imas_opener.py:47-73 follows the file's Recorder/monkeypatch idiom and names the mechanism (test_opener_passes_a_dd_version_string_unchanged) with no plan, ticket or version label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the single construction site at nova/imas/dataset.py:540 is untouched by the delta, which only records and defends it.
justifications.reuse: the delta adds no production name; a capability search over tests/ for an existing DBEntry recorder found only tests/test_equilibrium_wall_dd_version.py:29, which records constructor kwargs rather than opener forwarding, and the delta's Recorder predates this delta.
justifications.scope_discipline: the three changed paths (docs/evidence/fragments/nova-portfolio-replan/replan-dbentry-constructor.html, nova/imas/AGENTS.md, tests/test_imas_opener.py) are all inside the source node's declared write paths and add nothing the goal does not imply.

verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against 2a8ae1f8f; 3cd2f931a adds a Version type assertion, a version-string pass-through test and two backend assertions plus the AGENTS.md worked-example rewrite, and 18e65a69e rewrites only the evidence fragment.
verdicts.done_when: the done_when asks for a one-site search, a base-fail/head-pass test and a two-arm suite with no added failure; the delta's logs show tests/test_imas_opener.py 8 failed at base and 8 passed at head and no head-only failure id, but the arms ran sequentially rather than concurrently as its third clause requires.
verdicts.goal: the goal is to route every imas.DBEntry construction through one opener; the delta only hardens that landing and its record, and git grep "imas.DBEntry(" over nova/ at 18e65a69e returns exactly one line, nova/imas/dataset.py:540.
verdicts.manifest: read; its baseline_suite and after_suite record completed:true with 79 and 70 ids and its negative-control note matches the three scratch logs, but its tests: line and baseline_suite.command name a tests/test_uri.py-only run the harness did not execute.
verdicts.write_paths: the two delta commits touch docs/evidence/fragments/nova-portfolio-replan/replan-dbentry-constructor.html, nova/imas/AGENTS.md and tests/test_imas_opener.py, all three inside the source node's declared write path list.
